description: Lt Col Semasinghe Wanninayake Tikiri Bandara v Secretary of the Ministry of Defence and Others Lt Col Semasinghe Wanninayake Tikiri Bandara v Secretary of the Ministry of Defence and Others View More before Hon. S. Srikandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: Lt Col Semasinghe Wanninayake Tikiri Bandara v Secretary of the Ministry of Defence and Others Lt Col Semasinghe Wanninayake Tikiri Bandara v Secretary of the Ministry of Defence and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the decision of the 2nd Respondent to recover money from the Petitioner on the basis of illegal procedure adopted by the Court of Inquiry; Difference between a Court of Inquiry and a disciplinary inquiry; Special Rules made under Note 2 of Financial Regulation No 102 Relating to Losses of Three Armed Forces. Held - Petitioner failed to show unlawfulness of the decision, and the said recovery is only a surcharge. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Army Courts of Inquiry Regulations of 1952
